profile.name: Pravin Sail
profile.headline: Enterprise Transformation & Architecture Lead | Regulated Life Sciences | Integration, Governance, Product Strategy, Digital Operations, and AI-Enabled Workflow Design

summary: Enterprise transformation and architecture lead with 13+ years of experience connecting business capabilities, systems, data, and governance across regulated life sciences environments. Strong background in target-state architecture, integration strategy, SAP-connected process design, digital manufacturing and laboratory workflows, regulated product and platform governance, and finance-aware delivery planning. Experienced in bridging business, science, QA, operations, IT, vendors, procurement, finance, and commercial stakeholders to align roadmaps, operating models, investment decisions, and implementation-ready process designs. Current focus includes individualized medicine, sample-to-data-to-manufacturing workflows, LES and automation integration, and enterprise orchestration across site and global landscapes. In parallel, builds AI-enabled knowledge, retrieval, diagramming, transcription, and local-first workflow tools across Swift, TypeScript, Python, and web stacks.

professionalExperience.title: Digitalisation Lead, Product Supply of Individualized Medicine

Define future-state workflows across tissue, blood, histology, genomics, and manufacturing handoffs for patient-specific mRNA operations, including end-to-end traceability, exception handling, and evidence continuity.
Lead workshop-based decomposition of future-state workflows across sample receipt, blood processing, tissue processing, histology, genomics, and sequencing-related activities.

Develop BPMN-oriented process models and capability views covering execution logic, traceability checkpoints, exception paths, and system responsibilities across laboratory, automation, quality, and enterprise functions.
